GET STARTED

Move the app,
connect your agent.

Tacto 1.0.0-rc.4 is a release-candidate DMG for Apple Silicon, currently in stable-release qualification. Anyone can download it; it was verified on macOS 27.0.1 · Apple Silicon.

Download Tacto for Mac
The Tacto runtime and Flow format are the same for both.
  1. 01

    Install the Tacto app

    Open the DMG, drag Tacto into the Applications folder, then open Tacto from Applications. If you open it directly inside the read-only DMG, it will ask you to move it first.

    Tacto release candidate notes
    For developers: build from source

    Requires Python 3.11+, uv, Xcode Command Line Tools and an Apple-issued code-signing certificate. The DMG is recommended for regular use. 

    git clone https://github.com/Open330/tacto.git
cd tacto
uv sync
./build.sh
./skill/install.sh
    Installation requirements and signing setup
  2. 02

    Turn on two macOS permissions

    In the Tacto window, under ‘1. Mac 권한’ (Mac permissions), press ‘설정 열기’ (Open Settings) for each item and follow the guide beside it: allow app control for Tacto Helper and screen recording for Tacto. If you are switching from Preview 8 or earlier, grant each permission again to the new Tacto app. After connecting your agent in step 3, you can also check from the terminal with the command below.

    ~/.local/bin/tacto doctor
  3. 03

    Connect Claude and get started

    Once both permissions are on, press ‘에이전트에 연결’ (Connect to agent) in the Tacto window to connect the command and skill to Claude Code and Codex. Then send the request below in a new conversation. Feel free to swap in the app and task you actually need.

    Use the Tacto skill to calculate 12 × 34 in Calculator and verify the result. Save it as a parameterized Flow so I can run it again with different inputs.

    If your agent cannot find the skill, restart its conversation session and check the ‘2. 에이전트 연결’ (Agent connection) status in the Tacto window.

GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions.

Can I use both Claude and Codex?

Yes. The install script connects the skill and the Tacto command for both agents. Saved Flows are not tied to a model. In the development version, the automatic selector repair CLI option is --auto-repair codex, and the automatic repair provider is Codex.

Is there really no model cost?

Normal deterministic replay does not call a model. First authoring, judgment steps included in the plan, and supported failures after automatic repair is enabled do use the model. It does not mean the cost of the app or the execution environment is zero.

What happens if the screen changes?

Tacto finds the target again from a fresh observation. Supported static-selector failures can be repaired with a short candidate packet and resumed after a verified checkpoint. It stops if a value, state or target has changed, or if the outcome is uncertain. Automatic resume that needs an earlier capture, every UI change and crash recovery are not supported.

Is installation just one download?

Almost. Move the Developer ID–signed and notarized DMG’s app into Applications and open it, turn on two macOS permissions, then connect your agent in the app. This is currently a release candidate, verified on macOS 27.0.1 · Apple Silicon. Intel Mac and Windows builds are not provided. Installing only the Python wheel does not give you the signed macOS helper. Current status: release candidate, not yet the stable release.

How do I apply this to my work?

Start with tasks like creating documents from set content, entering many records into the same form, or checking results after input. Complete and verify one case in the app you use first, then save the steps to repeat as a Flow. Compatibility with each business app needs to be checked individually.
